business_summary: Colowide Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in restaurant management business in Japan and internationally. It also engages in purchasing and selling various foodstuffs and processing sales, as well as tobacco and alcoholic beverages. The company also manufactures and sells confectioneries, baked goods, and chocolates, as well as sauces for commercial and consumer use; sells and distributes liquors and other related beverages; and provides catering services. In addition, it is involved in the planning, operation and maintenance of IT systems, call center administration services; and product development, procurement, manufacturing, and logistics for various food products, as well as provides catering services. Further, the company operates the Wolfgang Puck restaurant; and Izakaya, Japanese, and Italian Cuisine. The company operates its restaurants under the Doma Doma, Kamadoka, Gyu-Kaku, Shabu Shabu On-Yasai, Tonkatsu Kagurazaka SAKURA, FRESHNESS BURGER, Gyu-Kaku Yakiniku Shokudo, Gyu-Kaku Buffet, Ajifurai Kagurazaka SAKURA, Steak MIYA, KALUBI TAISHO, GANKO-TEI, NIGIRI-NO-TOKUBE, KATSUDOKI, KAISEN ATOM, Wagyu Steak SAKURA, CHIISANA MORI COFFEE, Grillé Mia, Kamakura Kabuto, OOTOYA Gohan-Dokoro, NAGISA BASHI CAFÉ, CANTINA, TEMPURA MATSUI, and Mitsumori names. It also provides management and franchises, as well as sells products, and supplies ingredients and other materials. Colowide Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.
